about_the_game:
We are glad to present you the first DLC for our cozy and hot visual novel Coffee&Boobs - GRAND GALA! It's brighter, bolder and hotter than ever before! Get ready and don't forget to brew yourself a cup. There's a lot of exciting things to come!

Unexpected allies. When Saskia Swallow needed to perform a small miracle and save the grand banquet, who would she turn to for help? Well, to her old friends, the "Serenity" coffee house, of course.

Dive into the world of the rich and famous. Avian Conglomerate is a gathering of influential people, and only your decisions will determine whether these powerful people will be satisfied with a multi-day banquet. It's your responsibility to satisfy their whims. But you always have someone to rely on - the ever-reliable staff of "Serenity", of course.

New faces. You'll meet more than just old acquaintances during this new chapter! Be prepared for unexpected encounters that will not leave you indifferent. Will you get along with new people? Or will your paths part forever? Of course, it all depends on you.

Secret desires. Hot sex scenes are waiting for you. In response to fan requests, the C&B universe's premier MILF Saskia Swallow will let you close to her gorgeous body... If you deserve it! But these are far from the only horny adventures that await you at the Grand Gala!

Pleasant surprises. We listened to the wishes of fans and prepared something interesting. What is it? Play to find out! You will not regret it!

Choices and consequences. As always, choices do matter. What ending will you get? Whose heart (and bed) will you find your way into? Will you live up to the title of the Maestro's heir or suffer defeat? It's up to you.

The story continues! Find out how the new - and hopefully not the last - chapter of Serenity's adventures ends. Sam and his team need your support!
